concept.title: Router
concept.shortdesc: A router is the central networking device in a home network. It connects the home network to the Internet and manages communication between connected devices.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The connects to the and provides Internet access to connected devices.
The router serves as the central connection point for devices on home network.

section.title: Role of the Router
section.p: The directs data between devices on the local network and Internet resources.
It enables multiple devices to share a single Internet connection.
The router also manages communication between wired and wireless devices that are connected to the network.

section.title: Router Connectivity
section.p: The connects to the through the .
Wired devices connect to the router through available Ethernet ports, such as .
Wireless devices connect to the Wi Fi network broadcast by the router.

section.title: Router Functions
section.p: The router performs several functions to support network connectivity.

ul.li: Provides Internet access to connected devices.
Routes data between the local network and the Internet.
Connects multiple devices to a single network.
Acts as the central communication point for the home network.

section.title: How a Router Fits into a Home Network
section.p: The router operates between the and connected client devices.
All network traffic between connected devices and the Internet passes through the router.
